author: Screen Junkies
description:
Can you believe we’ve never made Honest Trailers for each individual Lord of the Rings movie in the trilogy? With all of them returning to theaters this month, we decided to do the same! So let’s take a nice long walk through the extended edition of The Fellowship of the Ring.

Voice Narration: Jon Bailey the EPIC VOICE GUY (@epicvoiceguy on all socials)

Written by: Spencer Gilbert and Lon Harris
Produced by: Spencer Gilbert
Edited by: Kevin Williamsen

Manager, Video Operations: Tiffany Tse

VP Content: Max Dionne
